title: Number of Ways to Arrive at Destination
goal: Count shortest routes from vertex zero to vertex n-1.
strategy: Dijkstra tracks both shortest distance and number of ways. Better distances replace counts; equal distances add counts. Strictly positive weights keep settled predecessor counts final.
